mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{uid} AND is_admin=1

SELECT rl.id AS row_id,COALESCE(pi.nickname,pi.username,'推荐人') AS inviter_name, COALESCE(pt.nickname,pt.username,'被推荐人') AS invitee_name, o.order_no,rl.level AS tier_level,rl.rate,rl.base_amount AS base_fee, ROUND(ABS(COALESCE(rl.amount,0))/100.0,2) AS amount_cny, rl.status AS row_status,rl.revoked_reason,rl.created_at AS made_at FROM t_reward_ledger rl LEFT JOIN t_profiles pi ON pi.id=rl.inviter_id LEFT JOIN t_profiles pt ON pt.id=rl.invitee_id LEFT JOIN t_orders o ON o.id=rl.order_id WHERE rl.currency='cny' ORDER BY rl.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.id,o.buyer_id,o.goods_amount,o.service_fee FROM t_orders o WHERE o.trip_id=#{id} AND COALESCE(o.pool_slot_no,0)>0 AND o.status IN ('requesting','negotiating','vendor_deposit_pending','locked') ORDER BY o.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_deposits SET status='refunded',reason=CONCAT('拼单解散退款：',#{reason}),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE order_id=#{id} AND party_role='buyer' AND status='frozen'
UPDATE t_orders SET status='cancelled_no_fault',closed_reason=CONCAT('拼单解散：',#{reason}),updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notifications(id,user_id,kind,title,body,created_at,read_flag) SELECT UUID(),id,'announcement',#{title},#{body},NOW(3),0 FROM t_profiles WHERE #{scope}='all' OR (#{scope}='buyer' AND COALESCE(user_role,'buyer')='buyer') OR (#{scope}='carrier' AND COALESCE(user_role,'buyer')='carrier')
mapper.select: SELECT id,status,publisher_id FROM t_demands WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_quotes SET status='rejected' WHERE demand_id=#{id} AND status='open'
mapper.select: SELECT id,owner_id,carry_mode,pool_status,pool_slots FROM t_trips WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT buyer_id) FROM t_orders WHERE trip_id=#{id} AND COALESCE(pool_slot_no,0)>0 AND status NOT IN ('cancelled_no_fault','cancelled_breach','closed')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_trips SET pool_status='formed',updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notifications(id,user_id,kind,title,body,order_id,created_at,read_flag) SELECT UUID(),o.buyer_id,'pool_formed','你参与的拼单已成团','运营确认该趟拼单成团，请按行程时间正常履约。',o.id,NOW(3),0 FROM t_orders o WHERE o.trip_id=#{id} AND COALESCE(o.pool_slot_no,0)>0 GROUP BY o.id,o.buyer_id
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM t_profiles WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_profiles SET banned_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 365 DAY)NULL WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_orders WHERE (buyer_id=#{id} OR vendor_id=#{id}) AND status NOT IN ('completed','cancelled_no_fault','cancelled_breach','closed')
mapper.update: UPDATE t_trips SET status='paused' WHERE owner_id=#{id} AND status='active'
